sentences.text: The genus is known from a single partial tarsometatarsus fossil, a bone in the lower leg.
The shaft of this bone was very flat and short.
The distal head of the bone suggests strong development of the toes.
Cladornis belongs to the parent group Cladornithidae.
The species is formally classified in the family Cladornithidae.
Cladornis lived in Argentina during the early Oligocene.
It existed between 33.9 and 23.04 million years ago, spanning the Rupelian to the Chattian stages.
The taxonomic placement of Cladornis remains uncertain among scientists.
